Reports about their plans that do not come from them or their campaign

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If Elon Musk endorses the Democratic candidate for President in the 2028 U.S. presidential election, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An endorsement is defined as any of the following, made after Issuance:
An explicit public statement (written, verbal, televised, or via social media) by Elon Musk expressing support for, backing, or endorsing the Democratic candidate for President in the general election
A public declaration stating intent to vote for the Democratic Presidential nominee in the general election
Serving in an official campaign role (e.g., campaign chair, co-chair, or honorary chair) for the Democratic Presidential nominee
Making any monetary contribution (including in-kind contributions) to a Democratic candidate's campaign in the general election, political action committee, or affiliated organization, as reported by any Source Agency

The following do NOT constitute an endorsement:
Positive comments about a candidate without explicit endorsement
Attending events without speaking or being featured as a supporter
Private expressions of support not made public
Endorsements for primary elections only
Endorsements for Vice President, Senate, House, or other offices

If Elon Musk endorses and then withdraws the endorsement, his endorsement status at Expiration governs.
markets.title: Will Elon Musk endorse a Democrat for President in 2028?

events.title: Will Elon Musk endorse a Democrat for President in 2028?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close after the Republican party nominates an individual for the Presidency and they accept that nomination.
markets.rules_primary: If the winner of the first state nominating contest wins and accepts the nomination for the Presidency for the Republican party in 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The first state nominating contest is the earliest 2028 Republican presidential nominating contest held in any of the 50 states that reports a statewide count of votes for candidates. A state's contest is the statewide primary or caucus that allocates the most Republican national convention delegates from that state (the earlier one if two allocate the same number). For Michigan, Montana, New Mexico, Oregon and South Dakota, the contest is the state-run Republican presidential primary, whether or not it allocates or binds national convention delegates. If contests in more than one state are held on the earliest date, the one that allocates the most delegates counts. A contest is held on its last day of voting.

The winner of that contest is the candidate with the most votes in its final round of counting, not delegates or state delegate equivalents. "Uncommitted" and similar ballot options are not candidates. If no state contest is held, the market resolves to No.
markets.title: Will the winner of the first state nominating contest be the Republican Presidential nominee in 2028?

custom_strike.Candidate: the first candidate the Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) endorses before Mar 7, 2028

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close after the Democratic party nominates an individual for the Presidency and they accept that nomination.
markets.rules_primary: If the first candidate the Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) endorses before Mar 7, 2028 wins and accepts the nomination for the Presidency for the Democratic party in 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Endorsements are determined per the specifications of the ENDORSE contract, treating the organization named in the market as the endorser. The first endorsement is that organization's first qualifying endorsement of one or more people for the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination, made after Issuance and before Mar 7, 2028.

A single statement or ticket that endorses more than one person at the same time, such as a president and a vice president, or one urging members or affiliates to support any of several candidates, counts as one first endorsement that names each of them. A statement that a person has or will have the organization's endorsement qualifies if the only condition attached is that the person enter or remain in the race; a statement conditioned on anything else does not. Later endorsements, and any later withdrawal of the first endorsement, do NOT change which endorsement was first.

The Democratic nominee refers to the person formally nominated for President at the 2028 Democratic National Convention. If the first endorsement names more than one person, the market resolves to Yes if any of them becomes the Democratic nominee. If the organization makes no qualifying endorsement before Mar 7, 2028, the market resolves to No.

Only the national organization can make a qualifying endorsement, acting through its national governing bodies or processes and announced through its official national channels. An endorsement, vote or statement of support from a local, state or regional chapter, local union, affiliate or caucus does not qualify unless the national organization adopts it.
markets.title: Will the first candidate the Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) endorses before Mar 7, 2028 be the Democratic Presidential nominee in 2028?

This market resolves on the statewide primary or caucus that allocates the most Republican national convention delegates from Iowa (the earlier one if two allocate the same number). The winner is the candidate with the most votes in its final round of counting, not delegates or state delegate equivalents, and only a projection of that candidate counts toward accelerated determination. "Uncommitted" and similar ballot options are not candidates. If no statewide primary or caucus allocates delegates or reports a statewide vote count, there is no winner.

markets.rules_primary: If a party founded by Elon Musk contests the 2028 U.S. presidential election by having at least one candidate officially on the ballot before Sep 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: A party "contests" an election if they have at least one candidate on the official ballot under the party name, participate in a formal coalition on the ballot, or have officially endorsed candidates with clear party affiliation. The party does NOT contest if they only endorse other parties' candidates, announce a boycott, fail to meet ballot access requirements, or only challenge results after voting without having participated. For multi-round elections, appearing on any round's ballot counts. For federal systems, contesting in any state/province counts for the federal election. If the election is postponed but occurs within one year, the contract remains valid. If cancelled or not held within one year, the market resolves to No.

markets.rules_primary: If Lupita Nyong'o performs/ is announced as any role as an actor in Black Panther 3, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For the purposes of this Contract, Lupita Nyong'o satisfies the Payout Criterion if either:

Official Announcement:
Lupita Nyong'o is officially announced, confirmed, or publicly credited as cast to perform any role as an actor in Black Panther 3, regardless of whether the performance ultimately occurs; OR

Actual Performance:
Lupita Nyong'o appears on stage, on screen, or in recorded content as any role as an actor in any official performance, showing, or release of Black Panther 3.

Additional clarification(s):

If Black Panther 3 is entirely cancelled or abandoned before any official performance or release occurs, but Lupita Nyong'o was officially announced in any role as an actor, the Contract will resolve to “Yes.”

If multiple people are announced for any role as an actor (e.g., alternating cast, dual casting), and Lupita Nyong'o is among them, the Contract will resolve to “Yes.” b

The Contract may resolve to “No” prior to the Expiration Date if:
(a) Black Panther 3 is cancelled or completes its run without Lupita Nyong'o being announced or performing in any role as an actor, or
(b) another person is officially announced as the sole exclusive performer for any role as an actor.
markets.title: Will Lupita Nyong'o perform as any role as an actor in Black Panther 3?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if any component becomes impossible to occur (resolving to No) or all components have been satisfied (resolving to Yes).
markets.rules_primary: If ALL of the following occur: Spanish general election winner: People's Party, Next Prime Minister of Spain: Alberto Núñez Feijóo, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This is a combination market requiring ALL specified outcomes to occur for the contract to pay out. If ANY single component resolves to No or becomes impossible, the entire contract immediately resolves to No, except where a component's own ruleset provides a different resolution. Each component is resolved according to its corresponding Kalshi ruleset: Spanish general election winner (ELECTION), Next Prime Minister of Spain (GOVHEAD). The election component must be satisfied before Aug 22, 2028 at 10:00 AM ET and the prime minister component before Aug 22, 2028 at 10:00 AM ET.

For parliamentary elections, the winner is the party, coalition, or alliance winning the most seats in the Congress of Deputies. This component applies to the next Spanish general election, scheduled for Nov 29, 2026. For purposes of this Contract, seats won by the Socialists’ Party of Catalonia (PSC-PSOE) count toward the Spanish Socialist Workers’ Party (PSOE). If two or more parties have the same number of seats, the one entering government wins the election component. If more than one or none of the tied parties enter government, the one with the higher share of the vote wins the election component. The election component may resolve early once a consensus of designated media sources has declared a winner.

The prime minister component resolves to the first person who, as a result of government formation following that election, is formally appointed, sworn in, or invested as Prime Minister according to Spain’s constitutional procedures, commands the confidence of the Congress of Deputies, and exercises the full powers of the office (not serving in a caretaker/acting capacity from the previous government). If no government forms before Aug 22, 2028 at 10:00 AM ET, or if new elections are called before government formation, the prime minister component resolves to No for the named candidates.

Each component is resolved according to its corresponding Kalshi ruleset: Spanish general election winner (ELECTION), Next Prime Minister of Spain (GOVHEAD). The election component must be satisfied before Aug 22, 2028 at 10:00 AM ET and the prime minister component before Aug 22, 2028 at 10:00 AM ET.

For parliamentary elections, the winner is the party, coalition, or alliance winning the most seats in the Congress of Deputies. This component applies to the next Spanish general election, scheduled for Nov 29, 2026. For purposes of this Contract, seats won by the Socialists’ Party of Catalonia (PSC-PSOE) count toward the Spanish Socialist Workers’ Party (PSOE). If two or more parties have the same number of seats, the one entering government wins the election component. If more than one or none of the tied parties enter government, the one with the higher share of the vote wins the election component. The election component may resolve early once a consensus of designated media sources has declared a winner.

The prime minister component resolves to the first person who, as a result of government formation following that election, is formally appointed, sworn in, or invested as Prime Minister according to Spain’s constitutional procedures, commands the confidence of the Congress of Deputies, and exercises the full powers of the office (not serving in a caretaker/acting capacity from the previous government). If no government forms before Aug 22, 2028 at 10:00 AM ET, or if new elections are called before government formation, the prime minister component resolves to No for the named candidates.
